Start here Wedding Registry Major congrats, youve just gotten engaged! And with an engagement comes excitement but also appointments, planning and a lot of unanswered questions. Then you need to find the best wedding registry to help happily ever after become a reality. Enter Macys Wedding Registry a celebration destination that delivers the building blocks for your newlywed home. Our process is simple. To begin, click create a registry and fill out the required fields. Youll have the option to book an appointment with a Celebrations Consultant for personalized advice on fun gifts for newlyweds and the must haves on a wedding registry. Or, if youre eager to get started, you can add all the goodies to your bridal registry as soon as youre set up. If youre starting super fresh, you may not be sure what to put on your wedding registry in the first place. Dont worry, weve got the checklist that outlines all your domestic necessities. And even if youre very, very cohabitated with your partner, its never a bad idea to register for wedding gifts youll actually WANT to receive. Your honeymoon might call for a tricked-out new luggage set , or youre craving a fun appliance for the kitchen ( air fryer , anyone?) Go ahead, this is the time to treat yourselves. Explore our curated guides to find an aesthetic that says us. Make things clean and minimalist or create a colorful, eclectic feel throughout the home. Perhaps you and your sweetie have a hobby you want to nurture. Weve rounded up the best-of-the-best products for cooking, entertaining, staying fit and so much more. Whichever direction you want to take, well show you which products can bring that vision to life. Finally, we cant forget the big day itself! The Wedding Shop at Macys has everything you need for a picture-perfect bridal party. Get your bride vibes on point with gowns, shoes , handbags, and showstopping jewelry that brings out your sparkle. We also have womens wedding attire for your maids and mother of the bride, and even flower girl dresses for the mini members of the party. And dont forget outfits for the groom and groomsmen ! Suits, formal shoes and ties are all waiting inside. Once your wishlist is made, all you have to do is alert the masses. Be sure to put where youre registered on the invitation so your loved ones know what to get you. Then, youll be ready to receive. With Macys wedding registry, all you need for love is right here.
